title: Live vNext text-shadow preflight exposes an I0 structured-contract conflict

root_cause.observed_output: The real I0 Draft emitted natural-language scene_hint values such as 雨后站台 and 旧城火车站.
root_cause.local_rejection: The deterministic I0 assembler rejects every scene_hint except the exact current machine partition ID scene-a10-rain-platform: I0 scene_hint may only name the current explicit partition.
root_cause.contradiction: The A4 provider-visible schema exposes optional scene_hint to the model, while the downstream local validator treats that field as a canonical machine partition identifier. Under v3.0, models may produce Draft semantics but must not mint or own canonical IDs. The live model therefore follows the natural-language meaning of the field and is correctly rejected by the local runtime.
root_cause.why_source_rewrite_is_not_a_repair: Changing titles or prose in this one raw script cannot make an arbitrary model omit or reproduce a machine ID. It would only mask the conflicting provider-visible contract and would fail again on another legitimate script.

required_fail_closed_action.current_package: A10 must stop without media acceptance, owner approval, VEC/Projection claim, v4 write, or production switch.
required_fail_closed_action.correct_preceding_owner: A4 owns prompts, schema registry, structured provider transport, and A4 tests. Its provider-visible I0 Draft surface must be repaired so local code, not the model, owns the current scene partition identifier.
required_fail_closed_action.downstream_effect: Because A4 behavior changes all provider-driven downstream stages, A4 and every dependent completed package A5 through A9 require ReleaseLedger invalidation and revalidation before A10 may restart.

minimal_repair_constraints: Do not relax local canonical-ID validation by accepting arbitrary free-text scene labels.
Do not instruct the model to invent or echo a canonical ID as a substitute for local ownership.
Do not create a second fact, VEC, Projection, or time authority.
Constrain or remove the provider-visible I0 scene_hint transport field, and have deterministic local code attach the already-known current partition where required.
Retain a fail-closed live-provider regression that rejects natural-label-to-machine-ID leakage without treating a model response as canonical evidence.
